title: 有馬記念の後に・吹き続け、どこまでも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen comes to an end with Yamanin Zephyr emerging victorious. As if race length is a totally arbitrary concept to her, she becomes a quadruple-distance champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio challenges Zephyr to a rematch. She vows that next time, she'll catch the wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zephyr promises to take her on as many times as she wants. After all, the wind never stops blowing.
